description:
Communities competing for Seedit's /s/pics route. The highest-rated finalized candidate resolves the route. Subscriptions and post links continue to use exact community addresses.

https://github.com/bitsocialnet/lists/blob/master/seedit-directories/seedit-pics-directory.json
rules: Submit photographs or still images, not screenshots, screen-focused pictures, animations, videos, or AI-generated images.
Do not add captions, emojis, or other digital text directly onto the image.
Use a concise, accurate title that describes what the picture shows.
No pornography or gore; mark other mature material appropriately.
Do not reveal personal information, encourage harassment, or organize witch-hunts.
Link directly to the image or a reputable image host rather than an unrelated landing page.
Do not falsely claim ownership, flood the community, or repost material as original content.
Remain civil in titles and comments.
